XCAPITOLO.Capitolo: SERVICING IN ACCORDANCE WITH BER/2010 REGULATIONS
XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
• Use original quality spare parts or parts that correspond to the original.

  • Use lubricants in accordance with the manufacturer's specifications.



  • Indicate the type of lubricant used (brand, trade name, viscosity and specification) on the compliance sheet and invoice.

  • Indicate the type of spare part used (brand, spare part code) on the compliance sheet and invoice.
